recommendation: Keep the source fix. It narrowly restores the Published FHIR-37549 event mapping in current build-scope source without changing the later related backbone design; broader DocumentReference/XDS mapping review should remain tied to the already represented FHIR-43408 work.
issue_request: FHIR-37549 was Published/Not Persuasive with Modification for R5 DocumentReference. It noted that Composition had an event element with no corresponding DocumentReference mapping useful for XDS DocumentEntry.referenceIdList, and the OO resolution clarified that DocumentReference.event already exists as a CodeableReference and should be mapped to referenceIdList.
initial_application: Commit a31aac85a1e6913e8593606957711b98db1c7ec3, linked from the Jira comment, added DocumentEntry.referenceIdList to the XDS mapping for DocumentReference.event. A later 2024 DocumentReference mapping update, d63adb6a17972d47bde74e7377febe531b104a9a, moved referenceIdList onto DocumentReference.related while leaving DocumentReference.event mapped only to eventCodeList.
additional_context: DocumentReference is active build-scope source through source/fhir.ini, and current Composition/DocumentReference source still maps DocumentReference.event to Composition.event.detail. FHIR-43408 and the 2024-04-30 OO minutes later reviewed broader DocumentReference/XDS mappings and continued to list event as mapping to DocumentEntry.referenceIdList, while separately discussing related as another referenceIdList catch-all. FHIR-53824/FHIR-53550 later refined DocumentReference.related into a coded backbone for non-lifecycle associations not already represented elsewhere, which does not reverse the event-specific mapping.
reconciliation: Changed source/documentreference/structuredefinition-DocumentReference.xml so the XDS map for DocumentReference.event is DocumentEntry.eventCodeList, DocumentEntry.referenceIdList. The existing DocumentReference.related referenceIdList mapping remains for other related-resource use cases.
